preconditions.description: The number of strings in the array a is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The minimum number of strings a substring must appear in is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The length of each string ai is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The total length of all strings ai does not exceed 10^5
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all strings in the array a does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: The output is a list of n integers, where the i-th integer is the number of pairs (l, r) such that the substring ai[l... r] is a substring of at least k strings in the array a.
postconditions.description: Each output integer corresponds to the number of valid (l, r) pairs for each string ai.
